usedFor: Kadoa holds workflow data and Brevo holds your contacts, so “Workflow Data” can run “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Data” in Kadoa, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: When workflow data changes, the contact is added or updated in Brevo, keeping your list current.

watchOut: “Workflow Data” is polling and fires on updates, so the same record can run “Add Or Update Contact” twice.
